newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp bid values Thyssen at DM13.62 bln.
newsitem.headline: Krupp bid values Thyssen at DM13.62 bln.

text.p: The offer of 435 marks per share for Thyssen AG made by Fried. Krupp AG values the company at 13.615 billion marks, acccording to Reuters calculations on the basis of the target group's share capital.

Thyssen has total basic share capital of a nominal 1.565 billion marks, consisting of 31.3 million shares with a nominal value of 50 marks each. The total value is calculated by multiplying the number of shares by the offer price.
Industry sources confirmed the assessed value was correct.
The total price paid by Krupp for an eventual successful takeover would be higher as it would also have to bear investment banks' fees and interest rate costs.
